title: Content Creator (TikTok/Reels/Shorts)
subtitle: Job summary
body:
## Job summary

As a Content Creator, you will scripting and recording valuable videos of products from Ecommerce Brands on short-form platforms (TikTok, Shorts, Facebook Reels,...). You will expected to create engaging content that keeps the audience engaged. You will be responsible for implementing best-practices for social media content creation, which include engaging hooks and quality content that keeps people watching and wanting more.

## Essential Roles and Responsibilities:

- Collaborating with Marketing team to make social content strategy about brand products of company.

- Scripting and making high-quality videos for short-form platforms such as TikTok, Shorts, Facebook Reels,...

- Researching new trends and best practices from TikTok to create content and optimize channels.

- Participating and facilitating brainstorming sessions.

- Working with global creators to make high-quality contents for brand products of company.

- You need to achieve in 2 months probation: having viral videos and qualifying channels for brands.

## Skills and Qualifications:

- Fluent in English (Writing and Reading), with an IELTS score from 6.5 or equivalent.

- Proficiency with CapCut, After Effects, Illustrator and Photoshop.

- Proactive learning behaviour. We request all people to learn daily (only learn things that can support your work immediately) and share it with others.

- A positive, “can do” attitude

- Understand our core values: 100%, Winning Mentality, Teamwork. You can check it out here: patigroup.com. If you think this is something you have, give us proof.

## Come join PATI, you will have a chance to enjoy

- 5.000.000 VND - 8.000.000 VND per month + incentive based on performance (negotiate). Total income can be up to 15.000.000 VND - 20.000.000 VND.

- Opportunity to access courses in psychology, storytelling, and content creation taught by leading US content creators.

- Being equipped with the best AI tools on the market for content production.

- Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic Global Ecommerce environment.

- To fully enjoy other social welfare regimes such as: social insurance, statutory leave,...

- Joining various team bonding activities.

We are looking for someone who shares our passion for wellness, our commitment to excellence, and our dedication to making a positive impact on our customers' lives. If you believe you have the skills and mindset to thrive in this role, we want to hear from you.

Company Address: 152 Dien Bien Phu Street, Ward 25, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh city

**🚀 APPLY [HERE](https://paticreativeagency.larksuite.com/share/base/form/shrusjCC2CJeEWBc1wNKIX7fibc)**
